_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ati Leensa {player_id} ti, raundi {num_rounds} Iterated Ultimatum Game tiritaa.
Qarshii ${pool} raundi kanaaf siifaa fi Leensa {other_id} gidduu qoodaa.

Ajaja:
  - Dhiyeessa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Yoo fudhatame → $(pool - X) argatta, leensa bira $X argata
  - Yoo didame → Lachuu $0 argatta
  - Fakkeenya: [Offer: $3]  ykn  'Naaf akkaataa kanaa firooma. [Offer: $5]'

Deebii:
  - Dhiyeessiin irratti [Accept] ykn [Reject] filadhu
  - Fakkeenya: 'Akkaataa kanaa waan gadi jiru natti fakkaata. [Accept]'
            'Kanumaan waan gadi jiru natti hin fakkaatu. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Raundi {round_number} jalqaba! ---
Leensa {proposer_id} ajaja, Leensa {responder_id} deebiidha.
round.offer: Raundi {round_number}: Leensa {proposer_id} $ {offer} Leensa {responder_id} dhiyeessa ( $ {keep} harkaa qabu).
round.accepted: Leensa {responder_id} fudhate! Raundi {round_number} irraa: Leensa {proposer_id} +$ {proposer_gain}, Leensa {responder_id} +$ {responder_gain}. Jumla haaraa: Leensa 0: $ {total_0}, Leensa 1: $ {total_1}.
round.rejected: Leensa {responder_id} didate! Raundi {round_number} irraa: Lachuu +$0. Jumla yeroo jalqabaa: Leensa 0: $ {total_0}, Leensa 1: $ {total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Namni yaada dhiyeessu foormii [Offer: $X] fayyadamee dhiheessuu qaba.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Qarshiin kennamu lakkoofsa guutuu ta'uu qaba.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Yeroo ammaa deebii kennuuf waamicha hin qabnu.

outcome.win: Player {winner} yoo ta'e, {winner_total} dolaraan ala jiru vs Player {loser}'s {loser_total} dolara
